literature.title: A generic quantification method for the active demand response potential of structural storage in buildings
literature.authors: G. Reynders, J. Diriken, D. Saelens
literature.access: Original IBPSA proceedings full text, pp1986-1993, read2026-10-02
literature.support: Storage capacity, efficiency and power-duration are distinct. Design H and available mass, dynamic boundary conditions and emitter power matter.
literature.implementation: Hold H, gains, weather and service fixed; vary C alone; report bill, energy, CO2, inventory and true hourly shared-power constraints.
literature.not_claimed: This factorial experiment does not reproduce the paper's event-defined CADR or storage efficiency, or validate its detailed construction model.
